identificationModule.briefTitle: Neugranin in Breast Cancer Participants Receiving Doxorubicin/Docetaxel
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Active Comparator, Non-Inferiority Study of Subcutaneously Administered Neugranin (Recombinant Human Albumin-Human Granulocyte Colony Stimulating Factor) or Pegfilgrastim in Subjects With Breast Cancer Receiving Myelosuppressive Chemotherapy (Doxorubicin/Docetaxel), Followed by a Single-Arm, Open-Label Phase of Subcutaneously Administered Neugranin

leadSponsor.name: Teva Branded Pharmaceutical Products R&D, Inc.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Determination of the effect of neugranin on the duration and severity of severe neutropenia in participants receiving doxorubicin in combination with docetaxel.

armGroups.label: Double-Blind Phase: Pegfilgrastim
armGroups.description: Participants will receive pegfilgrastim 6 milligrams (mg), administered by subcutaneous (SC) injection once per chemotherapy cycle (approximately 24 hours after chemotherapy administration) for up to 4 cycles (each cycle length = 21 days). The chemotherapy regimen consists of doxorubicin 60 mg/square meter (m\^2) and docetaxel 75 mg/m\^2 administered sequentially by intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 of treatment for up to four 21-day cycles.

armGroups.label: Double-Blind Phase: Neugranin 40 mg
armGroups.description: Participants will receive neugranin 40 mg, administered by SC injection once per chemotherapy cycle (approximately 24 hours after chemotherapy administration) for up to 4 cycles (each cycle length = 21 days). The chemotherapy regimen consists of doxorubicin 60 mg/m\^2 and docetaxel 75 mg/m\^2 administered sequentially by IV infusion on Day 1 of treatment for up to four 21-day cycles.

armGroups.label: Open-Label Phase: Neugranin 40 mg
armGroups.description: Participants will receive neugranin 40 mg, administered by SC injection once per chemotherapy cycle (approximately 24 hours after chemotherapy administration) for up to 4 cycles (each cycle length = 21 days). The chemotherapy regimen consists of doxorubicin 60 mg/m\^2 and docetaxel 75 mg/m\^2 administered sequentially by IV infusion on Day 1 of treatment for up to four 21-day cycles.

interventions.name: Neugranin
interventions.description: Neugranin will be administered per dose and schedule specified in the arm description.

interventions.name: Pegfilgrastim
interventions.description: Pegfilgrastim will be administered per dose and schedule specified in the arm description.

interventions.name: Chemotherapy
interventions.description: The chemotherapy regimen for this trial consists of doxorubicin 60 mg/m\^2 and docetaxel 75 mg/m\^2 in combination

primaryOutcomes.measure: Double-Blind Phase: Duration of Severe Neutropenia in Cycle 1
primaryOutcomes.description: Severe neutropenia was defined as Grade 4 neutropenia (absolute neutrophil count \[ANC\] \<0.5 x 10\^9/liter \[L\]). The duration of severe neutropenia was calculated by cycle as the number of days from the first day in which the ANC fell below 0.5 x 10\^9/L after beginning a chemotherapy cycle until the participant had an ANC ≥0.5 x 10\^9/L within the cycle.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Open-Label Phase: Duration of Severe Neutropenia in Cycle 1
primaryOutcomes.description: Severe neutropenia was defined as Grade 4 neutropenia (ANC \<0.5 x 10\^9/L). The duration of severe neutropenia was calculated by cycle as the number of days from the first day in which the ANC fell below 0.5 x 10\^9/L after beginning a chemotherapy cycle until the participant had an ANC ≥0.5 x 10\^9/L within the cycle. There was no planned statistical analysis for the open-label phase arm.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Double-Blind Phase: Number of Participants With Febrile Neutropenia
secondaryOutcomes.description: Febrile neutropenia was defined as an imputed or observed ANC \<0.5 x 10\^9/L and body temperature \>38.5 degrees celsius (°C) occurring on the same day and for more than one hour (axillary measurement). Number of participants with febrile neutropenia over all cycles (Cycles 1 to 4) has been reported.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Open-Label Phase: Number of Participants With Febrile Neutropenia
secondaryOutcomes.description: Febrile neutropenia was defined as an imputed or observed ANC \<0.5 x 10\^9/L and body temperature \>38.5 °C occurring on the same day and for more than one hour (axillary measurement). Number of participants with febrile neutropenia over all cycles (Cycles 1 to 4) has been reported.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Breast cancer participants scheduled to receive the AT regimen (doxorubicin/ docetaxel)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants may have received no more than 1 prior chemotherapy regimen (including adjuvant therapy if given within the last 12 months)
